text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said in a statement it maintained its neutral rating for Brazilian steel maker Cosipa.
-- It said Cosipa reported a third quarter loss of 57.6 million reais against its estimate of a 13 million real net profit.
-- It said the third quarter loss was not as bad as the disastrous second quarter loss of 103 million reais noting that operational performance again fell short of expectations.
-- It said it increased 1996 expected loss to 201.4 million reais from 99.5 million reais to incorporate third quarter results and expectations of a poor operational performance in the last quarter.
-- Cosipa preferred shares closed at 0.85 real Monday.
